messages:
Leah CS: Quick heads-up — Cortexa (trial) is running an investor webinar Thurs 08:00 JST and asked if we can open a scoped APAC + EU allowlist and a short QPS bump. They said if the demo stalls it's a renewal risk (pilot-to-paid). Can we scope to 40 qps for 90m and auto-revoke?

Diego Ops: @Leah please post source IPs and whether they need regional routing (ap-northeast vs eu-west). Also which endpoints?

Leah CS: Org: cortexa-pilot (CID: CTX-22). Endpoints: /v1/chat and /v1/embeddings. IPs: 198.51.100.12/32, 198.51.100.13/32, 2001:db8:feed::/64. Request TTL: 2026-04-20T03:00Z. Demo is APAC primary but they will mirror to EU for attendees.

Diego Ops: Opening ticket and adding both ap-northeast-1 and eu-west-1 edges. Will tag as temporary demo exception.

infra-bot: Ticket #CS-4859 opened by Diego Ops — temp allowlist (ap-northeast-1, eu-west-1) + qps bump. Link: https://redwood.ops/tickets/CS-4859

Priya Eng: Re: model selection — recommend pin to `rwd-small-2` for predictability, enable fallback to `rwd-tiny` if congested. Also suggest enabling short KV warmup for frequent prompts.

Tom SE: For hosted customers we can do a soft_qps lift to 45 with hard cap 60. If they need 40 sustained, soft=45/hr should be safe. Will need ops to approve cross-region allowlist.

Diego Ops: Approved by oncall. Applying allowlist to both regions and setting soft_qps=45 hard_qps=60 for org CTX-22. Auto-revoke set to 2026-04-20T03:00Z. Adding note about model pin + kv warmup.

infra-bot: CS-4859 updated: allowlists applied (ap-northeast-1, eu-west-1), soft_qps=45, hard_qps=60, auto_revoke=2026-04-20T03:00Z. Assignee: Diego Ops. ETA 10m.

Leah CS: Can someone confirm TLS SNI passthrough is fine? The customer uses a reverse proxy with SNI.

Priya Eng: SNI passthrough handled at edge; no extra config needed for these IP CIDRs. Confirmed.

Tom SE: Pushed a short playbook step for demo lifts:

```
Demo exception playbook:
1) Collect org id + CIDRs + TTL
2) Open CS ticket -> ops ticket
3) Apply allowlist to region(s)
4) Soft_qps bump + hard cap
5) Pin model + enable kv warmup
6) Monitor tokens/latency + notify CS
7) Auto-revoke at TTL and close ticket
```

Diego Ops: Done. Monitoring dashboards: org=CTX-22 prewarmed, tail latency looks normal. Will alert if error rate >1%.

infra-bot: CS-4859: monitoring active, prewarm run complete.

Leah CS: Customer verified live responses. I logged the renewal touchpoint and scheduled a follow-up the week after demo. Thanks team :sparkles:

Tom SE: Nice — good luck on the demo! :thumbsup:
